caption: The drawing depicts a wooden toy wagon with a reddish-brown body and visible wood texture and grain. The wagon consists of a curved, hollow body with higher ends at the front and back, and lower and slightly sloping sides. The front and back ends have upright, curved extensions that are integrated into the wagon's form. Four circular wooden wheels, also colored brown and showing visible grain patterns, are attached to the base of the wagon. A long, straight wooden handle is attached to the right front corner of the wagon, projecting diagonally upward and to the right. The wagon and handle are situated against a plain, light beige background. There are some visible scratches and marks on the sides of the wagon body. The composition centers the wagon horizontally on the page, with the handle reaching towards the upper right corner. The artist's signature, "Christi Markends," is in the lower right corner.
title: Doll Cart
